translations.Health search requires extra care. SEEKV: Health search requires extra care. SEEKVERA can help route users to providers, but important medical decisions should be made with qualified professionals and legitimate facilities.
translations.Search nearby services, transport, food,: Search nearby services, transport, food, shopping, family needs, utilities, emergency help and local information. SEEKVERA routes each request to the right service or trusted source.
translations.Choose any country or city. SEEKVERA can: Choose any country or city. SEEKVERA can help you discover tourist places, build an AI trip plan, find hotels and transport, open maps, check nearby essentials and look for public Wi-Fi.
translations.Messages sent to the SEEKVERA AI assista: Messages sent to the SEEKVERA AI assistant may be processed by external AI infrastructure used to generate a response. Only send information you are comfortable sharing for that purpose.
translations.Health content is informational and is n: Health content is informational and is not a medical diagnosis. Travel, safety, legal and financial information can change and should be independently verified when the decision is important.
translations.You left the crash site with a knife, ja: You left the crash site with a knife, jacket, water and a bag. The jungle is now the game world. From here the full Part 1 can continue with water, shelter, fire, animals and the first night.
translations.Individuals and businesses can advertise: Individuals and businesses can advertise lawful products, property, vehicles, jobs, services and equipment. Every new ad stays pending and is not publicly listed until it passes safety review.
translations.Emergency results should prioritize veri: Emergency results should prioritize verified official police, ambulance, fire, hospital and embassy contacts for the user’s country and location. SEEKVERA should never invent emergency numbers.
translations.Marketplace, user-submitted links, media: Marketplace, user-submitted links, media, profiles, offers and future sections should inherit SEEKVERA’s centralized Safety Gate rather than creating separate safety logic for every department.
translations.entertainment discovery must use officia: entertainment discovery must use official/licensed providers and respect regional availability. Safety Gate protections apply to user-submitted entertainment links, comments, media and listings.
translations.Find lawful entertainment options availa: Find lawful entertainment options available in your country. SEEKVERA can guide users to official streaming, rental, purchase, music, game and reading providers instead of hosting pirated content.
translations.Users may report suspicious or unlawful: Users may report suspicious or unlawful content. SEEKVERA may act on valid legal requests and may preserve or disclose information when required by applicable law, court order or lawful authority.
translations.Hosting comparisons should consider reli: Hosting comparisons should consider reliability, renewal pricing, support, backups, email needs and where the audience is located. The cheapest first-year offer is not always the cheapest long term.
translations.Solar should be sized around actual load: Solar should be sized around actual load, hours of backup, battery chemistry and local installation conditions. A cheap package can become expensive if it is undersized or built with poor components.
translations.Two-minute flight opening, crash, then t: Two-minute flight opening, crash, then the first survival objectives: wake up, search the wreckage, take a jacket, knife, water and bag, leave the crash site, reach the river and make the first camp.
translations.Cross-border trade can produce larger tr: Cross-border trade can produce larger transaction values, but supplier verification, product specifications, shipping terms, customs and payment protection matter more than finding the lowest unit price.
translations.He came for a quiet trek near the edge o: He came for a quiet trek near the edge of the rainforest. One wrong path, no signal, and daylight is disappearing. Find water, make a fire, recover useful gear, reach shelter and keep moving toward people.
translations.SEEKVERA can guide and organize the trip: SEEKVERA can guide and organize the trip, but visa rules, official travel advisories, emergency numbers and opening hours can change. Verify critical travel information with official sources before acting.
translations.Education searches include very differen: Education searches include very different needs: a student looking for a course, a school buying management software, or a professional comparing certification programs. SEEKVERA keeps those intents separate.
translations.Start inside the aircraft, survive the c: Start inside the aircraft, survive the crash, collect what you can from the wreckage, then walk into the jungle. This preview uses the realistic visual direction you approved — not the cartoon-style 3D build.
translations.Job seekers need verified vacancies, cle: Job seekers need verified vacancies, clear role requirements and safe application channels. SEEKVERA's job section is intended to route users toward legitimate platforms and employers as partners are verified.
translations.Property search should separate long-ter: Property search should separate long-term rent, shortlets, land and property-management tools. Prices alone do not tell the full story: agency fees, service charges, location, utilities and verification matter.
translations.These platform rules help reduce risk bu: These platform rules help reduce risk but do not replace local legal advice. Marketplace laws differ by country, so SEEKVERA should obtain jurisdiction-specific legal review before large-scale commercial launch.
translations.With your permission, SEEKVERA uses your: With your permission, SEEKVERA uses your phone location to look for nearby places in OpenStreetMap data that are tagged with Wi-Fi or internet access. Availability is community-supplied and may not always be current.
translations.SEEKVERA is a global discovery and compa: SEEKVERA is a global discovery and comparison project. The zero-cost MVP helps users organize a need by country and category, then routes them toward eligible third-party providers as partner relationships are approved.
translations.SEEKVERA is an information, discovery, r: SEEKVERA is an information, discovery, referral and marketplace interface. Third-party sellers and providers are responsible for their listings, ownership, permissions, legal compliance, delivery and service performance.
translations.You may use SEEKVERA only for lawful pro: You may use SEEKVERA only for lawful products, services, travel, property, jobs, businesses and information. You must follow the laws that apply to you, the item or service, and the country where the activity takes place.
translations.New or edited ads, user media, links, pr: New or edited ads, user media, links, profiles, offers and future user-generated features should inherit the same Safety Gate. Unsafe or uncertain content stays blocked or pending rather than being published automatically.
translations.The architecture separates routine resea: The architecture separates routine research/negotiation from paid actions and irreversible owner approvals. Background email execution is not claimed active until secure app-side OAuth and scheduled execution are connected.
translations.SEEKVERA does not require an account for: SEEKVERA does not require an account for basic search and discovery. Do not submit passwords, payment-card details, government ID numbers or other highly sensitive information through search, Request Anything or the AI assistant.
translations.Business software should fit the workflo: Business software should fit the workflow, not the other way around. A restaurant may need table ordering and kitchen flow; a retailer may care more about stock, multiple branches and receipts; a hotel may need rooms and reservations.
translations.Some current or future tracked links may: Some current or future tracked links may use cookies or attribution technologies under the destination provider or affiliate-network privacy policy. SEEKVERA may receive a commission without increasing the price charged to you by the destination provider.
translations.A low sticker price is not enough. A use: A low sticker price is not enough. A useful comparison should consider warranty, seller reputation, delivery, return policy, voltage or network compatibility, and total landed cost. SEEKVERA will activate tracked merchant links only after partner approval.
translations.Users must verify identity, ownership, t: Users must verify identity, ownership, title documents, product authenticity, licences, permits, prices and payment instructions before completing a transaction. SEEKVERA is not the merchant of record for ordinary third-party listings unless a specific transaction clearly states otherwise.
translations.SEEKVERA may earn a commission when a us: SEEKVERA may earn a commission when a user completes a qualifying purchase, booking, subscription or referral through certain tracked links. This should not create an extra charge to the user unless the provider clearly states otherwise. Partner compensation is not intended to be the only ranking factor.
translations.SEEKVERA AI may refuse requests that inv: SEEKVERA AI may refuse requests that involve prohibited or illegal goods, services or content. Automated moderation can make mistakes, so suspicious content may also require manual review. Users must not try to bypass safety checks by changing spelling, using coded language or hiding prohibited content in images.
translations.By posting an ad, you confirm that you o: By posting an ad, you confirm that you own the item/property/content or are authorized by the owner to advertise it. You also confirm that you have the right to use every photo, video, document and description you upload. You must not advertise another person's house, land, vehicle, business or belongings without permission.
translations.Weapons, ammunition, explosives, militar: Weapons, ammunition, explosives, military/police uniforms or combat equipment, explicit nudity/pornography or sexual services, controlled drugs, stolen/counterfeit goods, fake documents, scams/fraud, trafficking, extremist/terrorist material, privacy abuse, and other illegal goods or services. Unsafe ads are blocked or rejected.
translations.New marketplace ads may be screened by a: New marketplace ads may be screened by automated safety checks and may remain pending until reviewed. SEEKVERA may reject, hide, remove, restrict or preserve records of content that appears unsafe, unlawful, misleading or unauthorized. Approval is not a guarantee that a listing is genuine, legal in every jurisdiction or risk-free.
